name: Chester County Preservation Partnership Program: Conservancy Grants
summary: Matching grants from Chester County for nonprofit land conservation organisations to buy land or easements for natural area preservation and to improve public access. The same programme also funds municipalities and farmland easements.

status.quote: Applications must be received by 4 p.m. on April 30, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications must be received by 4 p.m. on April 30, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: grants to municipalities and nonprofit land conservation organizations to permanently preserve natural, recreational, and agricultural open space resources

geography.quote: The Commissioners of Chester County, Pennsylvania offer the Preservation Partnership Program

access.quote: How to Apply: Submit digital files to: Monica Mullaji at mmullaji@chesco.org

window.quote: Round 38 of the Preservation Partnership Program anticipates the award of approximately $2 million in open space funds.

co_finance_required.quote: Natural Area Preservation grants fund a maximum of 50% of the appraised value to buy land, conservation easements, or trail easements plus eligible transaction costs.
